payload.title: Preserve valid Unicode at semantic task truncation boundaries
payload.description: Frozen collector slices task text at40000 UTF-16 code units. A valid original description with an emoji across that boundary returned a lone high surrogate (55357), sourceTruncated true and isWellFormed false. Truncate at a complete code point, retain explicit truncation and consistent content hashes; cover Hebrew/astral content and real worker ingestion. No live-model inference was needed to reproduce this collector fault.
